description: For a guaranteed preview-only request, use prepare_design_review instead; design_yard can start generation when reusing a confirmed review. Start a professional landscape design for a property: a 2D site plan plus front-yard and backyard 3D views, saved to the user's Yarda account. Takes about 2 minutes. Homeowners and professionals can use the account's shared no-card Pro-design trial; call get_account for the actual remaining allowance. It is not a separate allowance per agent or client. After that it uses the account's Yarda Pro plan or credits (refunded if it fails). Confirm the address returned by find_property and pass its property_ref when available. The first call normally answers with status 'review_required' instead of a job: the result itself shows the property preview (satellite image with the estimated outline, and the design brief) and its true approval_status. Nothing is charged before approval. Show the preview to the user. When in_chat_approval is true, the user approves by pressing 'Generate design' in the Yarda card shown with this result, and the card then starts the design itself and shows its progress and result in the chat. No approval link is needed then, so do not tell the user Yarda will send them a link first; the optional 'Edit or refine this design in Yarda' link (studio_url) is fine to offer if the outline or details look wrong, and opening it never approves anything. Only when approval_status is awaiting_approval and in_chat_approval is false, give them the labelled secure review link (review_url) to approve on Yarda. You can never approve for the user: a chat message such as 'yes' or 'approve' is not approval, and repeating the call before they approve just returns the same review. If the preview is still preparing, do not call design_yard again; the card updates itself, or read it with get_design_review. When the user approved outside the card, or the card asks you to continue, call design_yard again with the same review_id and latest returned review_revision, preserving the original address, style, features, focus, notes, language, property_ref and idempotency_key when supplied; leave optional fields omitted if they were omitted originally. If an outline edit causes a new review_required response with a newer revision, retry using that revision. Once started it returns a job_id right away; then call get_design with that job_id (it waits up to 45 seconds per call) until the status is 'succeeded'. If the status is 'payment_required', nothing was charged: stop generation attempts and explain the account limit. Do not retry or change address/account/client to bypass it. Ask whether the user wants payment options. Only after an explicit user request, call the tool named in checkout_tool (subscribe) for a secure checkout link. Never collect card details in chat. Temporary rate or budget limits are not payment_required and must not trigger checkout.

address.description: The confirmed property address (use the address find_property returned)

back_features.description: Backyard features, e.g. Patio, Pergola, Fire Pit, Swimming Pool, Outdoor Kitchen, Water Feature, Lawn Area, Decking

front_features.description: Front yard features, e.g. Front Garden, Lawn Area, Stone Pathway, Driveway, Outdoor Lighting, Flower Beds, Privacy Hedges, Arbor / Trellis

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same request so it isn't charged twice

language.description: Language for the labels drawn on the plan and 3D views and the design text: 'es' for Spanish (use it when the user or their client speaks Spanish). Default: the account's preferred language, else English

notes.description: Anything else the designer should know: materials, plants to keep, the client's taste

property_ref.description: The property_ref from find_property, so the review prepares against that exact lookup

review_id.description: The review_id from a review_required result — send it back unchanged after the user confirms

review_revision.description: The revision from the review_required result

style.description: Design style name or id from list_styles (default 'Modern Minimalist')

name: design_yard

approval_status.description: When review_required: the review's true state. Only the user's own approval changes awaiting_approval

brief.description: When review_required: the design brief frozen with the review

checkout_tool.description: When payment is required: the tool that returns a checkout link (subscribe)

in_chat_approval.description: When review_required: true = the user approves with the Generate button in the Yarda card shown with this result

next_step.description: When review_required: what to do next

preview_status.description: When review_required: whether the property preview (image, outline, brief) is shown with this result

review_expires_at.description: When review_required: when the review link stops working (ISO 8601)

review_id.description: When review_required: send it back to design_yard unchanged after the user confirms

review_revision.description: When review_required: the revision to send back with review_id

review_state.description: When review_required: preparing = wait and retry; ready = waiting on the user; confirmed = start the design

review_url.description: When review_required and in-chat approval is unavailable: the secure page where the user approves the property outline

status.description: succeeded = design ready; queued/running = keep polling; payment_required = stop generation and ask whether the user wants payment options; call checkout_tool only after an explicit user request, never automatically; temporary rate or service limits are not payment-required; review_required = the user must approve the property preview before the design starts (nothing charged): with the Generate button in the Yarda card when in_chat_approval is true, otherwise on the secure review page (review_url)

studio_url.description: Where the user can edit or refine this design in Yarda's web app (finished design, saved designs, the review's outline editor or Design Studio). Opening it never approves, starts or charges a design

title: Design Yard
